name: Bogolan
description: Mudcloth: hand-painted rows of marks, a row of dots, a row of crosses, a zigzag and a ladder, in pale earth on a dark ground.

code.style: --rule: ( --k: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } @match(y % 4 == 1) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 38%; height: 24%; background-color: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, #000 72%, transparent 78%) 0 0 / 33.333% 100%; mask: radial-gradient(closest-side, #000 72%, transparent 78%) 0 0 / 33.333% 100%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } @match(y % 4 == 2) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; top: 22%; width: 56%; height: 56%; background-color: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 16.0% 0.0%, 50.0% 34.0%, 84.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 16.0%, 66.0% 50.0%, 100.0% 84.0%, 100.0% 100.0%, 84.0% 100.0%, 50.0% 66.0%, 16.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 84.0%, 34.0% 50.0%, 0.0% 16.0%); clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 16.0% 0.0%, 50.0% 34.0%, 84.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 16.0%, 66.0% 50.0%, 100.0% 84.0%, 100.0% 100.0%, 84.0% 100.0%, 50.0% 66.0%, 16.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 84.0%, 34.0% 50.0%, 0.0% 16.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } @match(y % 4 == 3) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 30%; height: 40%; background-color: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 25.0% 70.0%, 50.0% 0.0%, 75.0% 70.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 30.0%, 75.0% 100.0%, 50.0% 30.0%, 25.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 30.0%); clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 25.0% 70.0%, 50.0% 0.0%, 75.0% 70.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 30.0%, 75.0% 100.0%, 50.0% 30.0%, 25.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 30.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } @match(y % 4 == 0) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 28%; height: 44%; background-color: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0, transparent 0%, #000 0% 14%, transparent 14%, transparent 86%, #000 86% 100%, transparent 100%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0, transparent 0%, #000 0% 14%, transparent 14%, transparent 86%, #000 86% 100%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 34%; height: 32%; background-color: @var(--k); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 9.5%, #000 9.5% 15.5%, transparent 15.5% 25%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 9.5%, #000 9.5% 15.5%, transparent 15.5% 25%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
